title: Finite-volume scalar spectral constructive Gibbs measure
statement: On the fixed three-torus, for the real scalar Brazovskii kernel K(k)=m_sh^2+Y(|k|^2-q0^2)^2 with m_sh^2>0 and Y>0, and local potential lambda phi^4/4+gamma phi^6/6 with lambda real and gamma>0, K^{-1} is trace class, every sharp spectral Galerkin Gibbs measure is normalizable, and the full Galerkin sequence converges weakly on L2 to a finite-volume non-perturbative Gibbs measure; common-Gaussian lifted densities converge in L1/total variation and finite-degree smeared cylinder-polynomial correlations converge.
scope: T6 CONDITIONAL-THEOREM@FINITE-VOLUME-REAL-SCALAR-SPECTRAL: real scalar field on T3 with periods 16 under named hypotheses A1-SHELL-POSITIVITY and A2-H2-SEXTIC-COERCIVITY; positive shell mass, Y>0, q0>=0, arbitrary real lambda, gamma>0, beta=1, and sharp spectral/max-norm Galerkin projectors. Production-anchor values are derived sanity checks, not restrictions or predictions. Excludes the full three-complex-component derivative Class-II energy, eta_shell nonzero, zero/negative shell mass, unsmeared composite fields, infinite volume or thermodynamic limit, spontaneous phase transition, finite-difference lattice Route B, BCC existence/selection, T7, and P5 synthesis.
falsifier: A divergent trace of K^{-1} in the stated d=3 q^4 scope; failure of the quartic-sextic lower bound; a zero, infinite, or non-uniformly controlled Galerkin partition function; failure of P_N phi to converge in the Gaussian L6 control used for the interaction; non-tightness or two cutoff subsequences with different Gibbs limits; a correlation observable failing the declared convergence; or a failed source hash/audit reopens A4-CONSTRUCTIVE-MEASURE-CLOSURE.
